name: folder-open-lock
description: An open folder with a full lock shackle and a solid lock body.
useCase: Identify an expanded folder whose access is restricted.
misuse: Pair the icon with the folder name and expose its expanded state on the actual control.

16.reason: The complete front flap and rear tab stay clear of the full resource marker.

24.reason: The established open-folder body retains its full flap and tab with generous marker separation.
